productionOnly.name: public.agency_attestations.attestations_insert_facilitator
productionOnly.check:
((attester_actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (attester_organisation_id IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agency_evidence_items e
  WHERE ((e.id = agency_attestations.evidence_id) AND (e.actor_id <> ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.agency_has_cohort_role(e.cohort_id, ARRAY['facilitator'::text])))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_attestations.attestations_select_owner_or_attester
productionOnly.using:
((attester_actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agency_evidence_items e
  WHERE ((e.id = agency_attestations.evidence_id) AND ((e.actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.agency_has_cohort_role(e.cohort_id, ARRAY['facilitator'::text, 'auditor'::text]))))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_cohort_memberships.memberships_select_authorized
productionOnly.using:
((actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.agency_has_cohort_role(cohort_id, ARRAY['facilitator'::text, 'auditor'::text]) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (agency_cohorts c
     JOIN agency_programmes p ON ((p.id = c.programme_id)))
  WHERE ((c.id = agency_cohort_memberships.cohort_id) AND (p.owner_organisation_id IS NOT NULL) AND private.agency_is_organisation_operator(p.owner_organisation_id)))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_cohorts.cohorts_select_authorized
productionOnly.using:
(private.agency_is_cohort_member(id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agency_programmes p
  WHERE ((p.id = agency_cohorts.programme_id) AND (p.owner_organisation_id IS NOT NULL) AND private.agency_is_organisation_operator(p.owner_organisation_id)))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_credential_claims.credential_claims_insert_verified_self
productionOnly.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (agency_credentials c
     JOIN agency_evidence_items e ON ((e.id = agency_credential_claims.evidence_id)))
  WHERE ((c.id = agency_credential_claims.credential_id) AND (c.actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (c.status = 'issued'::text) AND (e.actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (e.cohort_id = c.cohort_id) AND (e.capability_id = agency_credential_claims.capability_id) AND (e.visibility = ANY (ARRAY['passport'::text, 'shared'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM agency_attestations a
          WHERE ((a.evidence_id = e.id) AND (a.status = 'verified'::text)))))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_credential_claims.credential_claims_select_via_credential
productionOnly.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agency_credentials c
  WHERE ((c.id = agency_credential_claims.credential_id) AND ((c.actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((c.cohort_id IS NOT NULL) AND private.agency_has_cohort_role(c.cohort_id, ARRAY['facilitator'::text, 'auditor'::text]))))))

productionOnly.name: public.agency_credentials.credentials_insert_verified_self
productionOnly.check:
((actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (credential_type = 'capability_passport'::text) AND (status = 'issued'::text) AND (cohort_id IS NOT NULL) AND private.agency_has_cohort_role(cohort_id, ARRAY['learner'::text]) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (agency_evidence_items e
     JOIN agency_attestations a ON (((a.evidence_id = e.id) AND (a.status = 'verified'::text))))
  WHERE ((e.actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (e.cohort_id = agency_credentials.cohort_id) AND (e.capability_id IS NOT NULL) AND (e.visibility = ANY (ARRAY['passport'::text, 'shared'::text]))))))

productionOnly.using: ((actor_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((cohort_id IS NOT NULL) AND private.agency_has_cohort_role(cohort_id, ARRAY['facilitator'::text, 'auditor'::text])))
